diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 4.75 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: Seeed specifies a nominal 5 V supply ('Power supply 5 Digital output mode TTL'), and the board's only active chip, the LMV358, is rated for 'low-voltage (2.7 V to 5.5 V) operational amplifiers', so the model's 4.75 V minimum is just the normal -5% tolerance of that nominal 5 V rail, not a different value.

diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 5.25 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: Seeed specifies a nominal 5 V supply ('Power supply 5 Digital output mode TTL'), and the LMV358 datasheet warns 'Supply voltages larger than 5.5 V can permanently damage the device', so the model's 5.25 V maximum is the normal +5% tolerance of the nominal 5 V rail and stays safely below the chip limit.
